Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’:
1. FOB ($) = Total Value in INR/Total Qty * ROE (Mentioned in cs exchange rate master), Note In FOB ($) always come data/Rate in $.
2. Discount Percentage = (100 × 5 + 200 × 10 + 50 × 2) ÷ 350 = 7.43%.

4. Column Name ‘A’, FOB in USD = Effective FOB ($), Column A always come as FOB in USD.
5. Column Name ‘B’, Conversion Rate = based on cs exchange rate master data will come here.
6. Column Name ‘C’, FOB in INR= A*B.

8. Column Name ‘G’, Total realisation in INR= Based on column C+D+E+F.
9. Column Name ‘H’, Total cost price same as per existing.
10. Column Name ‘I’, Margin in INR= G-H.

chunks.title: 1. Business Requirement
chunks.heading: 1. Business Requirement
chunks.text:
currently, users maintain Commission Agent and Commission Percentage in Buyer Master under Commission Definition. During Sales Invoice Clear & Posting, users are again required to manually select Commission % and Supplier before posting the invoice even when the information already exists in Buyer Master. This enhancement will automate the population of commission details, enforce mandatory validation, and provide controlled flexibility through user permissions.
In addition, the system currently does not provide a centralized mechanism to maintain Buyer-specific Discount Definitions based on business attributes such as Category, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category. As a result, users are unable to configure multiple discounts, define default discounts, or maintain discount applicability in a structured and reusable manner.
2. Objectives
• Reduce manual data entry during Sales Invoice Clear & Posting.
• Automatically populate commission details from Buyer Master.
• Ensure commission details are mandatory when applicable.
• Allow authorized users to edit or bypass commission validation.
• Improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.
• Provide a centralized mechanism to maintain Buyer-specific Discount Definitions within the Buyer Master.
chunks.locator: § 1. Business Requirement

chunks.heading: 3. Scope

• New user permission to bypass/edit commission.
• Introduce a new Discount Definition section under the Buyer Master → Financial Info tab.
• Automatic application of Discount Definitions during Sales Order.
• Changes to existing functionality of sales order, costing & shipment invoice.

• Column Name ‘G’, Total realisation in INR= Based on column C+D+E+F.
• Column Name ‘H’, Total cost price same as per existing.
• Column Name ‘I’, Margin in INR= G-H.
• Column Name ‘J’, Margin in %=I/G.
• Ttl Sales =

• INR= Similar of column name ‘I’.

chunks.title: 5. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.heading: 5. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.text:
• Single commission definition auto-populates successfully.
• Multiple commission definitions required manual selection.
• No commission definition follows existing behaviour.
• FA Setting disabled – feature inactive.
• Mandatory validation prevents posting without commission details.
• Users with bypass permission can edit or skip commission details.
• Accounting entries and Credit Note generation remain unchanged.
• Discount Definition is successfully maintained in the Buyer Master based on Category, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category.
• Only applicable and Active Discount Definitions are displayed in the Sales Order based on the selected Buyer, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category.
• Users can select multiple Discount Definitions using the multi-select checkbox control.
• Discount Definitions are displayed in the format Discount Name (Discount %).
• The Discount Percentage is automatically calculated as the sum of all selected Discount Definitions and remains read-only.
• The Effective Selling Price is automatically calculated based on the Selling Price and total Discount Percentage and remains read-only.
• Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price are displayed correctly across all supported Price Per options (Article, Color, Size, and Color/Size).
• The Total Value is calculated using the Effective Selling Price.
chunks.locator: § 5. Acceptance Criteria

chunks.title: 5. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.heading: 5. Acceptance Criteria
chunks.text:
• Duplicate Discount Names are not allowed within the same Discount Definition in Buyer Master.
• Only one Discount can be marked as the Default within a Discount Definition.
• Users without the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission cannot modify the Discount Definition through UI, EDI, LLM, or other integrations.
• Users with the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission can modify the Discount Definition during Sales Order revision.
• If Approval Hierarchy is enabled, any revision that changes the Effective Selling Price is routed for approval before the changes become effective.
• Discount Definition cannot be revised once the Sales Order has been partially or fully dispatched.
• Discount Definition, Discount Percentage, and Effective Selling Price are displayed correctly in all applicable screens, including Sales Order, Quantity Breakup, Update Order Confirmation, EDI Buyer PO, and Color/Size Detail.
• Existing Sales Order processing, dispatch, invoicing, accounting, and financial postings remain unaffected by this enhancement.
chunks.locator: § 5. Acceptance Criteria (part 2)
